source.training_source: Old locked weights; new validation-only threshold search
Old locked weights; new validation-only threshold search

protocol.architecture: Same per-site filters and event reset; trainable full quadratic matrix; diagonal starts zero
protocol.initialization: Exact archived per-cell voltage-fit checkpoint used by the original event trainer; not the later random-init experiment
protocol.data_policy: Reuse exact archived fit/validation manifest including existing prefixes; no new output-based selection. No test input evaluated by this trainer
protocol.candidate_policy: Preserve original training path; retain best positive-update joint/voltage snapshots and last state, in addition to original candidates. After full training, reset-calibrate ON/OFF pairs with identical shared threshold grid, source-reset anchor, candidate-reset warm start, amp/tau grid and local refinement. Validation only
protocol.optimizer: AdamW wd1e-6; cosine to 2% LR; clip 1; EMA .995; FP32 IEEE
protocol.voltage_loss: Original variance-balanced masked MSE + 0.1 squared physical derivative error; ref AP +/-10ms excluded
protocol.event_loss: lambda*(positive threshold hinge at nearest reference event sample + mean per-trace top-4 non-event hinge); margin .15 mV; negatives exclude reference +/-5 ms and padded tails
protocol.reset: Teacher reset fixed per stage; validation calibration; rebuilt residual before refinement
protocol.calibration: Bias+.025 through +24 mV, empirical validation pre-event levels, old reset; amp 4/8/12 and tau 8/16/40 ms, with local threshold refinement
protocol.validation_selection: Min pooled masked MSE + .02 normalized MSE + .25*(1-F1@5ms), among candidates within original validation RMSE + max(.05 mV,25%); old locked candidate retained
